purpose: Freeze the smallest explicit semantic decisions required before a pure EP3-to-EB0.4C adapter and one operation-level review candidate can be implemented.

primary_role.basis: Both contracts require SYSTEM_TRANSFER and LAUNCH_SIGNER and model funding/activation followed by creator-signed launch behaviour.

edge_features.basis: Union of declared topology edge semantics, normalized to operation-independent descriptions.

mechanism_features.basis: Exact intersection of declared primitive requirements in watchtower 1.0.0 and three_sw2 1.0.0, excluding watchtower-only WSOL_CLOSE.

temporal_features.basis: Both retained corpora contain proven BEHAVIOURAL_TIMING primitives; no cadence, periodicity, or dormancy value is inferred.

quality_and_completeness.proposed_rule: COMPLETE only when every selected common feature has at least one PROVEN observation and no selected observation has missing_inputs; otherwise PARTIAL. CONFLICTING only from explicit conflicting evidence, never absence.

operation_level_candidate.support_rule: Bind the two EP3 snapshots, all 13 behaviour observations, both topology revisions, both detector results, and only EP4 candidate identity digests as subject-level supporting context; do not copy address populations into F5.

must_record: decision for every null decision field
reviewer identifier or review record reference
explicit nomination_state only after reviewing the derived operation-level candidate
review_requirements.supported_guard: SUPPORTED remains invalid unless the adapter proves complete, nonconflicting, nonempty mechanism and temporal evidence for both operations.

implementation_after_approval: fixture-qualify a pure deterministic EP3-to-EB0.4C adapter
apply it once query-only to the immutable PSI0G-B2 bundle
emit one immutable operation-level review candidate
record a separate explicit human disposition
only then construct and replay an F13/F9 bundle
terminal_statement: Implementation is blocked on explicit semantic review, not missing code or missing retained evidence. Null decisions must not be auto-filled from behavioural similarity.
